question: Tony exercises every morning by walking 3 miles carrying a 25-pound backpack, then he runs another 10 miles without the backpack.  If he walks at a speed of 3 miles per hour and runs at a speed of 5 miles per hour, how many hours each week does he spend exercising?

If Jerry doesn't make any payments, how much (in dollars) does the loan shark charge in interest the second month?

question: To produce one chocolate bar, a company needs 1.5 grams of sugar. Every minute the company produces 36 chocolate bars. How many grams of sugar will the company use in two minutes?
